points.description: States time scale (length/duration of the process) as one of the two important scales.
States spatial scale (length/size or area of the process) as the other important scale.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming both a time scale and a spatial (length/space) scale in any wording. Give 1 mark if only one of the two is given. Give 0 for unrelated answers such as water availability alone or other scales. Ignore the "availability of drinking water" phrase in the model answer; it is not needed.
